title: MARK ELEVEN
THE MIDNIGHT WATCH
end: The Midnight Watch — stand in prayer at midnight
stock_queries: midnight watchtower silhouette under deep starry heavens
lone prayer lamp glowing softly in a dark stone room
vast mountain range under moonlight and drifting mist
calm sea waves under a brilliant starry night sky
ancient olive tree silhouette against a luminous midnight sky
peaceful sanctuary altar with soft candlelight in the dark

scenes.a: If that heavy mountain still blocks your path tonight, hear this.
For verily I say unto you, That whosoever shall say unto this mountain, Be thou removed, and be thou cast into the sea;
and shall not doubt in his heart, but shall believe that those things which he saith shall come to pass; he shall have whatsoever he saith.
Therefore I say unto you, What things soever ye desire, when ye pray, believe that ye receive them, and ye shall have them.
Lord, remove every doubt from our hearts in this silent hour.
May our faith rise to meet your holy word. Amen.
